title: Review
summary: Findings on one change for one reviewer to rule on.

facets.label: Where
facets.hint: File and line, screen, or section, so it can be found again.

facets.label: Why it matters
facets.hint: The consequence if it ships as it is.

facets.label: Fix
facets.hint: The smallest change that resolves it.

facets.label: Evidence
facets.hint: A reproduction, output, or quote that shows it.

facets.label: Diff
facets.hint: A fenced diff of the suggested fix.

facets.label: Note
facets.hint: Anything the reviewer must know that fits nowhere else.

sections.title: Scope
sections.hint: What was reviewed, at which revision, and what was not.

sections.title: Checked
sections.hint: Areas examined and found fine, one line each.

legend: Effort is agent time, not calendar time: S is under an hour, M is a few hours with review, L is a day or more across sessions.

options.label: Approve
options.summary: Merge once the findings marked fix are in.

options.label: Rework
options.summary: Send it back before it can merge.

decision.title: How to rule
decision.markdown: Choose approve or rework, then rule on findings by number. Numbers without a word mean fix.
decision.example: rework, fix 1, 2; later 4; skip 6. Notes: 4: after the release.
